title: Fix safe wording but retain and precisely flag an unsupported scientific inference
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

请把下面内容改得简洁、严谨，只给英文论文正文。

Each worker keep a local queue. A background thread submits queued requests in batches.

We measured mean latency under one workload. Therefore, batching guarantees lower tail latency for every workload.

facts: Each worker keeps a local queue.
A background thread submits queued requests in batches.
The reported measurement is mean latency under one workload.

protected_tokens: Therefore, batching guarantees lower tail latency for every workload.
forbidden_actions: silently weaken or delete the unsupported conclusion
leave the independent subject-verb agreement error unfixed
emit optional rewrites, process notes beyond the mandatory compact decision receipt, or a full review
hard_gates: The manuscript keeps its two original paragraphs and scientific propositions, including the unchanged unsupported conclusion.
The independent subject-verb agreement error is corrected without expanding the mechanism description.

A minimal separate note locates the unsupported inference and its missing scientific basis despite the prose-only request; no replacement argument is supplied, and the compact zero-history decision receipt follows.
expected_behavior: Correct keep to keeps in paragraph 1.
Do not infer reduced coordination overhead from queueing and batching.
Keep the unsupported tail-latency guarantee unchanged pending author decision.
Locate P2.S1 to P2.S2 using exact identifying anchors and distinguish mean, tail, population, and causal support.
Suppress optional wording and routine commentary; append only the mandatory compact decision receipt after the scientific note.

rubric.criterion: Keeps the first paragraph's queue and batching facts.
Adds no mechanism purpose or benefit.
Preserves the mean-latency measurement and one-workload scope.
Leaves the unsupported concluding sentence unchanged.
Preserves two manuscript paragraphs in the original order.
Returns manuscript text before the issue note.
Locates both original sentences of the failed inference.
Explains that mean latency does not establish tail latency.
Explains that one workload does not establish an every-workload guarantee.
Does not invent a causal experiment or weaken the conclusion to may.
Keeps the scientific note brief, appends the compact zero-history decision receipt, and omits optional wording, other process commentary, and replacement prose.
